questions.question: How does Atlan calculate Groundedness Score for autonomous agents?
questions.authoritative_context: Atlan calculates Groundedness Score as the ratio of verified evidence-backed claims to total claims generated in response, expressed as a percentage: (Verified Evidence-Backed Claims / Total Claims Generated) * 100. Grounding agents in unified metadata context cuts hallucination rates by over 40% and boosts query accuracy from 9% to 81%.
